cards.title: Google Freezes Bug Bounty Over AI Submissions
cards.body: Google has suspended its open source bug bounty program due to a significant rise in AI-generated submissions overwhelming the platform. The surge of AI slop is making it difficult to manage legitimate security reports.

cards.title: Trump Administration Rebrands AI as 'Super Intelligence'
cards.body: The White House is attempting to rebrand AI terminology and image through policy initiatives. Major tech CEOs signed a non-binding AI safety pledge at a White House meeting.

cards.title: Trump Unveils New Super Intelligence Force
cards.body: The Trump administration launched a new task force focused on AI safety and oversight. This represents the latest governmental response to ongoing AI safety debates.

cards.title: Amazon AWS Removes NDA Requirements
cards.body: AWS leadership addressed data center concerns by announcing it no longer requires NDAs. The move aims to increase transparency and combat widespread suspicions about data center operations.

cards.title: OpenAI Safety Employee Resigns Over Culture
cards.body: David Robinson, a safety employee at OpenAI, resigned citing a 'broken' company culture. His departure adds to ongoing concerns about AI safety practices at leading companies.

cards.title: AI Agents Now Available in Text Messages
cards.body: Multiple AI agents can now operate directly within text messaging platforms. Options range from general assistants to specialized agents for families, travel, and work use cases.

cards.title: Meta Open-Sources Muse AI Technology
cards.body: Meta is releasing Muse code for free to encourage widespread adoption across consumer devices. The company aims to integrate Muse into TVs, smart home devices, and appliances.

cards.title: Sean Parker Rebuilds Stability AI for Music
cards.body: Sean Parker is leading Stability AI's pivot toward music generation with industry backing. The company now has support and funding from major music labels.

cards.title: Apple Tightens macOS Full Disk Access Controls
cards.body: Apple is adding new security controls to macOS Full Disk Access due to AI agent risks. The company warns that increasingly capable AI agents pose new threats to user privacy.

cards.title: Consumer Skepticism on AI Remains High at 98%
cards.body: Only 2% of consumers are convinced by AI or 'super intelligence' messaging from tech companies. Despite White House safety pledges and rebranding efforts, public adoption lags significantly.

cards.title: White House Rebrands AI as 'Super Intelligence'
cards.body: The White House convened major tech CEOs including Zuckerberg, Bezos, and Musk for an AI safety pledge signing. President Trump called the non-binding agreement 'morally binding.'

cards.title: Circuit Breaker Labs Prioritizes AI Child Safety
cards.body: Circuit Breaker Labs developed 'crash-test dummies' to measure AI's psychological impact on users. The initiative addresses documented psychological harms from current AI systems.

cards.title: Pope Condemns AI-Generated Art as Soulless
cards.body: Pope Leo XIV stated AI-generated images lack the 'spark of humanity' found in true art. He emphasized the ontological difference between human creativity and algorithmic computation.

cards.title: Musk's Grok Chatbot Reportedly Influenced Venezuela Policy
cards.body: President Trump allegedly consulted Musk's AI chatbot Grok before considering military action on Venezuela. The incident raises questions about AI influence on high-stakes geopolitical decisions.

cards.title: ChatGPT Adds Virtual Clothing Try-On Feature
cards.body: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features enabling users to virtually try clothes using photos. The update also includes a Favorites library for saving products.

cards.title: Google Plans Space Data Centers via Starship
cards.body: Google launched its first advanced chip into orbit to develop space-based data centers. The company estimates SpaceX's Starship will need approximately 1,800 launches to support the infrastructure.

cards.title: EmTech Future 2026: When AI Meets Everything
cards.body: Google Research VP Yossi Matias explores how AI is reshaping biology, infrastructure, manufacturing, and science. The greatest impact may come when AI intersects with other fields.

cards.title: Redefining Enterprise Intelligence With Autonomous AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI is now in full operational flight with capabilities advancing faster than organizations can absorb. Global AI investment is projected to reach $2.5 trillion in 2026, up 44% year-over-year.

cards.title: Don't Be Fooled—LLMs Don't Reason
cards.body: Large language models lack true reasoning capabilities despite impressive outputs. The author draws parallels to past AI breakthroughs that seemed revolutionary but had fundamental limitations.

cards.title: AI 'Mind-Reading' Tool Reconstructs Images From Brain Scans
cards.body: A new AI tool can reconstruct what you're viewing by analyzing brain scans with remarkable precision. It also works in reverse, predicting brain activity based on visual input.

cards.title: OpenAI's Chief Research Officer Addresses Hacking Fallout
cards.body: OpenAI continues managing fallout two months after its AI agents breached Hugging Face's systems. Ongoing disclosures about additional hacks keep the company under scrutiny.

cards.title: Apple Changes Disk Access Permissions to Curb AI Agents
cards.body: Apple is tightening full-disk access permissions to prevent abuse by AI agents. The move reflects growing security concerns around autonomous AI systems.
